scripts.dev: pnpm -s build:packages && cp node_modules/ghostty-web/ghostty-vt.wasm www/ && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --external:'node:*' --format=esm --splitting --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --sourcemap --outdir=www --servedir=www --serve=127.0.0.1:8123
scripts.build: pnpm -s build:packages && cp node_modules/ghostty-web/ghostty-vt.wasm www/ && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --external:'node:*' --format=esm --splitting --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --sourcemap --outdir=www
scripts.build:component: cd component/todo-rs && cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip2 && cp target/wasm32-wasip2/release/todo_rs.wasm ../todo.wasm
scripts.gen:component: jco transpile component/todo.wasm -o component/gen --name todo --instantiation sync --quiet
scripts.build:odin: odin build backend-odin -target:js_wasm32 -o:speed -out:www/raster.wasm && cp "$(odin root)/core/sys/wasm/js/odin.js" www/odin.js
scripts.build:odin-gpu: odin build backend-odin-gpu -target:js_wasm32 -o:speed -extra-linker-flags:"--export-table" -out:www/gpu.wasm && cp "$(odin root)/core/sys/wasm/js/odin.js" www/odin.js && cp "$(odin root)/vendor/wgpu/wgpu.js" www/wgpu.js
